description: A detached single-storey home with a lower level, set on a landscaped lot with a curved driveway, clipped hedges and mature trees. Dark herringbone floors run through the main rooms, and black-framed floor-to-ceiling glass doors line several walls. The living room opens toward the pool, and a sitting area has a curved wall of windows facing a wide view. The dining room holds a long table and opens to a lounge area. The kitchen has grey cabinetry with glass-front uppers, stone counters, an island, a professional range and a skylight. Other rooms include a wood-panelled office, a home gym with a glass shower, and a bathroom with a large soaking tub. Outside are an in-ground pool, an outdoor fireplace, lawn terraces and glass railings.
highlights: Kitchen with island and professional range
